# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes. Pin a release tag or commit SHA, and update when a new release is published.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lowlysre/mwaa-update-env-action/security/advisories/new). Don't open a public issue, discussion, or pull request for a suspected vulnerability.

Include the affected version or commit, the workflow configuration that triggers the problem, and what an attacker could do with it. You'll get an acknowledgement within 7 days and a fix or a decision within 30 days.

## Verifying a release

Releases are immutable: once published, a release's tag can't be moved or deleted. Pin a full release tag such as `v1.0.0`, or the commit SHA it points to, to run exactly the code that was released. A floating major tag such as `v1` isn't a release, so it can move to newer code.
